messages:
Aisha: Heads-up, holiday mug swap in the kitchen fridge today! Bring your ugliest mug and a small treat to exchange. Rules: one mug per person, label if fragile. :mug:
Tom: I'm in. My mug has a tiny llama wearing a sweater. Highly competitive. :llama:
Diego: Photo or it didn't happen. Also can we make a cocoa recipe swap board? I have a killer chili-spiced cocoa. :fire:
Renee: Love this. Would be down for a cocoa recipe column + little post-it with ingredient list. Low-contact swap please. :handshake:
Aisha: Great. I'll pin a paper list on the fridge door and scan for remote folks. If anyone wants to drop a note with their recipe I can add it. Remote folks can DM me and I'll post (with credit).
Tom: Quick poll: do we want to do a tiny secret-santa-for-mugs twist? Draw names or just free-for-all? React with :one: for draw, :two: for free-for-all.
Diego: :one: — drawing names sounds fun and reduces mug pile chaos.
Renee: :two: free-for-all is fine if we put a sign that mugs are available for swap only.
Aisha: Poll result so far: 1 vote for draw, 1 for free-for-all. I'll leave poll open until 4pm.
ops-bot: Reminder: Kitchen fridge cleanout scheduled Friday 5pm. Unclaimed items will be moved to Lost & Found. :clipboard:
Tom: Also, small PSA: please label your mug with a name if you don't want it rehomed. Learned that the hard way last year. :sweat_smile:
Diego: Dropping my chili cocoa recipe here so it's saved before the fridge chaos. Feel free to copy:
```
Diego's Chili Cocoa:
- 2 cups milk (or oat)
- 2 tbsp cocoa powder
- 1 tbsp brown sugar
- 1/4 tsp cinnamon
- pinch of cayenne
Heat gently, whisk, top with whipped cream. Enjoy.
```
Renee: Yum. I'm adding a non-dairy peppermint hot-choc variation to the fridge note later.
Aisha: If you're remote and want to ship a mug, we have a small budget for shipping — DM me and include dimensions.
Tom: Taking a photo of my llama mug for proof. Anyone want to volunteer as official photographer? :camera_with_flash:
Renee: I'll take the glamour shots.
Diego: I'll also bring some marshmallows labeled "for Diego's cocoa" so people know which ones to use. Totally legal. :marshmallow:
Aisha: Ok final call: drawing names at 4pm, meet by the fridge at 4:30 for exchange. If you can't make it, leave your mug with the label and I'll arrange pickup. Thanks y'all! :sparkles:
